title: Advanced Chimneys
description: Adds chimney pipes that route smoke from any heat source outdoors, keeping your interior clean and particle-free
body:
![Chimneys](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba5032f261a087eaab7421569be66bf3b721c279_0.webp)

"Advanced Chimneys" lets you build customizable smoke ventilation systems from common building materials that redirect smoke from any heat source outdoors, eliminating interior particle clutter for a cleaner, more immersive aesthetic.

Construct simple vertical chimneys or complex ventilation networks using pumps, vents, and pipes.

Customize chimney appearance by repainting them with any block, and watch realistic smoke billow and shift in response to wind direction.

Connect multiple heat sources to intensify and amplify the smoke effect for truly impressive results.

## Core Functionality
- Craftable chimneys from common building materials - build with blocks you already have in your inventory
- Complex smoke ventilation systems - design sophisticated networks using pumps, vents, pipes, and hoppers to redirect smoke from any heat source
- Customizable chimney appearance - repaint chimneys to match any block using a brush in one hand, a sample block in the other, and a bucket of water and dyes in your inventory

## Smoke System
- Dynamic, responsive smoke particles - smoke collides with obstacles, reacts to wind direction, and shifts intensity based on what it passes through
- Scalable smoke effects - connect multiple heat sources to increase smoke volume and create dramatic visual effects
- Color variation - smoke color depends on connected sources and the path it takes through your system
- Transparent glass chimney blocks - build with glass for better scenics and visual clarity

## Customization & Compatibility
- Add custom smoke emitters - define smoke behavior for any heat source in your setup
- Fine-tune smoke properties - adjust color, amount, intensity, and scale to suit your expectations
- Wide mod compatibility - works seamlessly with industrial mods and modded furnaces
- Physics Mod support - switch to vanilla particles in config for full Physics Mod integration

**REQUIRES** [**ForgeEndertech**](https://modrinth.com/project/forgeendertech) **library**

Not immersed enough? Pair Advanced Chimneys with [**Pollution of the Realms**](https://modrinth.com/project/pollution-of-the-realms) for a complete atmospheric experience.
